book.name: ROM
book.title: ROM Rom mbal tuku waŋe Paulusŋge kuyarna

content: Paulus nu Rom mbal kaiye pasa niŋgina
Kristus tuku piro pino ande nyunu Febe tane nu tuku nyu kila palpe ŋga satiŋgamŋgit. Nu Senkrea tumbraŋ suŋgo mbolŋge Kristus tuku kuasmbi ŋgamukŋge piro kate.
Nu tane tugum ta prowa le tane Kuate tuku mbal minig ta te-mayokmba Suŋgo tuku nyu mbolŋge nu tap. Nu wam afu denkuwa kande turap. Nu tira kame suŋgomba ye mata turyina.
Prisila le Akuila nale ye ndoŋ Kristus Yesus tuku piro kigeŋ ta tane nale tuku gare pasa te sanikap.
Nalekam ta ye maye minam tuku ye turyumba kume dirnaik. Ta tuku kasomok mbal Kristus tuku kuasmbi minig ta nane ŋakmba ye ndoŋ nale gare pasa nikig.

Nale tuku wandekŋge Kristus tuku kuasmbi maŋgurkade mbal nane mata gare pasa te niŋgap. Mbal ŋakmba nyu kilamŋgit te yiŋe gare pasa te saniŋgap. Yiŋe gulab mayenu Epenetus. Asia mbal ŋgamukŋge nu amboŋga Yesus tuku son ŋgina.
Pino ande Maria tane ŋgamukŋge piro kareŋkina.

Andronikus nale Yunias sine tugu ndindo nale ye ndoŋ muli wandek sinamŋge mingeŋ. Ye Kristus gilai minen le nale amboŋga son ŋginaik. Aposel kame ŋgamukŋge nale nyu ŋak minik. Nane ŋakmba ta yiŋe gare pasa te niŋgap.
Afu teŋenmba. Ye tuku gulab mayenu Ampliatus.
Ande Urbanus nu sine ndoŋ Kristus tuku piro biyit. Ande Stakis nu ye tuku gulab mayenu ande.
Ande Apelis nu Kristus tuku taŋgo tugusek mayok kina. Aristobulus tuku ndare tuma mbal mata yiŋe gare pasa niŋgap.
Herodion nu ye ndoŋ tugu ndui ta. Narsisus tuku ndare afu Suŋgo tuku mbal minig ta ŋakmba yiŋe gare pasa te saniŋgap.
Afu teŋenmba. Suŋgo tuku piro kareŋkate pino ar Trifina nale Trifosa. Pino ande Persis nu mata Suŋgo tuku piro kareŋkate.
Tira ande Rufus nu Suŋgo tuku taŋgo tugusek. Ina nuŋe nu ye tuku ina taŋaŋ minit.
Asinkritus, Flegon, Hermes, Patrobas, Hermas tira afu nane ndoŋ minig.
Filologus, Yulia, Nerius nale kulim nuŋe Olimpas Kuate tuku mbal nane ndoŋ mine likade ta ŋakmba yiŋe gare pasa te saniŋgap.
Tane taŋgine taŋgine tira kame ndoŋ muŋgu kume purkade maŋau ta alonu te-mayokap.
Kristus tuku kuasmbi yimyam ŋakmbaŋge tane tuku kaiye pasa pilig le ilit.
Yabri tum mbal tuku riroŋ pasa
Tira kame, nane afu tane purka afu tuku wamdus tugusek didikade ta tane nane kila patika nane ndoŋ ulendi ndakap. Naneŋge sine pasa tugusek tumtiŋgigeŋ ta pitaide.
Nane siŋgine Suŋgo Yesus Kristus tuku piro mbal kuga. Nane naŋgine ŋgarosu tuku nzali ŋaigonu maro ŋak minam tuku ndo piro kade. Naŋgine ŋule parak pasambi tira afu wamdus saŋgri kugatok ta didikade.
Tane Kuate tuku miŋge dubi mayede ta nane ŋakmba isig. Ye wam ta tuku gare-gareket. Tane maŋau mayenu kam tuku kila suŋgo ŋak minap sulumba maŋau ŋayonu kam tuku gilai taŋaŋ minap.
Tane taŋamba minap ta Kuate nu pitik ndo Satan tumba tane tuku kupe kumnemŋge pilmba to firamŋgat. Kuate nu ŋgamuŋgal mukuk siŋgit tuku tugu. Sine tuku Suŋgo Yesus Kristus nu tane make patikuwa. Son.
Timoteus nu ye ndoŋ pirokate ta nuŋge tane kaiye pasa tiŋgit. Lusius Yason Sosipater nane ye tuku tugu ndui ta nane mata tane kaiye pasa tiŋgig.
Ye Tertius Paulus tuku miŋge pasa kuyaret te ye mata kaiye pasa tiŋget.

Gaius nu ye Paulus nu tuku wande mbolŋge minam tuku sakate. Nu Kristus tuku mbal ŋakmba mbolŋge wam mayenu ta kate. Nu mata tane kaiye pasa tiŋgit. Erastus nu tumbraŋ suŋgo te tuku ndametiŋ kulatkate taŋgo sine tuku tira Kuartus nale mata tane tuku kaiye pasa pilik.
[Sine tuku Suŋgo Yesus Kristus nu tane make patikuwa. Son.]
Paulus nu Kuate tuku nyu te-duŋgina

Sine Kuate tuku nyu te-duŋgube. Ye pasa mayenu Yesus Kristus tuku kukliwet ta Kuate nu ta mbolŋge tane saŋgri piletiŋgamŋgat. Pasa mayenu ta buk kuirok minna le taŋgo nane gilai mine suŋgona le ka ka kile nu kilimok mayok kinit.
Kuate nu minmba minit nu taŋgo ŋakmba pasa mayenu son ŋga dubiwaig ŋga iduste ta kilimok mayok kinit le kilke mbol mbal ŋakmba ise likeg. Tuan taŋgo kame tuku kuyar ta mbolŋge kilimok mayok kinit.
Kuate nu ndo wamdus kila ŋakmba ŋak. Sine ŋakmba Yesus Kristus mbolŋge Kuate tuku nyu suŋgo ta te-duŋga minmba minbe. Son.

footnotes.text: Zu mbal nane kume purkade maŋau ta alonu te-mayokmba muŋgu mumukade.
